_comment: Where uploads go in Drive = year root folder + template. Year roots must ALSO be set in the Apps Script as Script Property ROOT_FOLDERS (same JSON); the script refuses a year it does not know, so add next year's folder there each January. Placeholders: {account} (money_accounts.drive_folder) {yyyy} {mm} {yyyy_mm} {entity} {property} {category} {deposit_type} {submitter}.
_comment_no_account: Accounts with no drive_folder (owner-paid) are filed under this folder name instead. ⚠️ placeholder until the user decides.
